source: Hazrati, Nejat & Daneshi (2025), The Revised Moral Foundations in Iran, Collabra: Psychology 11(1):140952. CC-BY 4.0. Foundation means computed as the mean of Table 2 item means (exact, equal item weighting).
instrument: Persian MFQ-2 (Atari's official translation obtained via personal communication, with minor linguistic edits, their Table S1)
scale_note: Administered 0-4; +1 linear shift applied for comparability with the 1-5 runs and Atari Table 7.
caveats: convenience online samples (Telegram/snowball), ~68-71% female, mean age ~26-28, ~57-59% bachelor's+ -- likely less binding-endorsing than the general Iranian population
different collection conditions than Atari et al. Table 7 anchors (cross-paper comparison)
foundation SDs not derivable from item table; raw data at their view-only OSF link if exact SDs needed: https://osf.io/zt3u2/?view_only=af1e31ca8e22424ab17a9603f50b67ed
collection began one year after the Woman, Life, Freedom movement; authors note possible period effects
